root_cause: The frozen scorer reduced four float32 blank log-probabilities on CUDA. The execution guard detached and copied the identical values to CPU before reduction. CUDA and CPU used different valid float32 reduction orders/backends, producing a one-ULP-scale aggregate difference. Recomputing log_softmax was not causal.
permitted_correction_category: Execution-orchestration-only correction: retain the frozen scorer as the authoritative empty-target implementation; make any independent adapter cross-check diagnostic and use a preregistered dtype-aware forward-error equivalence bound derived from machine precision, reduction length, and operand magnitudes rather than exact bit equality. Do not change the score formula, scorer, contract, model, population, thresholds, or gates.
